components.name: Legend Row
components.description: Lettered balloon mirrored from the dial, name and tabular value, hairline divided.

narrative.overview: The whole screen is the front-view sheet of a watch service manual. The dial is drawn, not rendered: ink linework on drafting film, each complication named by a leader line that ends in a lettered balloon, and the same letters repeated in a legend beside it. The system lives in two themes from one set of rules: Folha (cool drafting film) and Bancada (pure black, white ink).
keyCharacteristics: Dial as a technical drawing: two line weights, dashed construction lines, leader lines at 0°, 45° and 90° only.
Lettered balloons on the dial mirrored one-to-one in the legend.
One condensed technical face with tabular figures for every role.
Red appears only for danger and for the beat of the seconds.
Hairline separators instead of boxed cells; rounded drafting-template corners.

rules.name: The Revision Rule
rules.body: Red means the movement can be hurt or this is the beat. Anything calm is ink or construction blue.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: The danger plate is the only reversed element on screen. Selection is never shown by ink reversal.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: One family carries every role; hierarchy comes from weight, size and ink tone.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Linework uses exactly two weights: heavy 2.6 and fine 1.1.

dos: Do draw every new complication with a leader line at 0°, 45° or 90° ending in a lettered balloon, and add the same letter to the legend.
Do keep linework at the two weights (2.6 and 1.1).
Do use tabular figures for every number that changes.
Do keep red for danger and the seconds beat; calm states use ink or construction blue.
Do design both themes for every change; Bancada is pure black, not dark gray.
donts: Don't imitate branded dials or real watch models.
Don't add ornament: no enamel textures, bevels, gradients, glow or skeuomorphic cases.
Don't use neon-on-black gamer styling in Bancada.
Don't mark selection by inverting ink; the danger plate owns reversal.
Don't box information into cells; divide with hairlines.
